rug_restatement_label: RUG full-loss restatement -$0.00 per owner rule (9 historical RUG exits booked residual value; ledger unchanged, see data/rug_discrepancy.json; cause UNVERIFIED)

rules.entry: LIMIT-TRIGGER (owner-approved 6:48 PM, live from C10): all signals captured to a watchlist (no liquidity/buys entry filter). Signal = 1h vol>=20k, 5m>+5%, 1h +10..80%, age<6h, mc<500k. Per coin: 5m-chart buy/sell momentum %, buying-zone low, paper limit trigger 1.5-6% below price. Paper-buy only after price dips to trigger then ticks up 1%+. Best score (1h% x buy%) fills free slots first. Watch expires 40 min. DIP ENTRY v9 (owner voice notes 1:59 and 2:14 AM IST 7 Oct): a coin is bought only when its price is 10% to 30% below its SIGNAL price (the price when first seen), not below its high. If it falls past -30% it is skipped. Liquidity must be known and at least $5,000 at the moment of buying (unknown liquidity is tracked, but never bought). Rug = liquidity under $3,000. Dip zone numbers -10..-30 are agent-chosen from the owner order to use options 2 and 3, thresholds 3k and 5k are from the owner voice note. Fills UNVERIFIED.
rules.exit: Per coin: 1.5x take-profit for ALL open positions (owner 11:05 PM; was 3x) (entries from the 11 PM IST cycle on: 1.5x take-profit, owner voice note 10:45 PM relayed) (instant sell when price touches 1.5x), -50% stop loss, rug = liquidity < $3k (full loss; owner 1:59 AM IST 7 Oct), otherwise sell at market exactly 60 min after its own entry. Owner rules 12:32 PM + 4:26 PM, restored 7:57 PM.
rules.rug: liquidity < $3,000 = full loss (only early exit; owner 1:59 AM IST 7 Oct)
rules.cooldown: 6h no re-entry on a coin that closed at or below 0.50x
rules.entry_filter_OLD: liquidity >= $15,000 (owner floor $5k, kept stricter), >= 50 buy transactions in the last hour (owner rule 18:09 IST; DexScreener counts buy txns, not unique wallets, UNVERIFIED), 1h volume >= $20k, 5m change > 5%, 1h change 10-80%, age < 6h, mc < $500k
